toc.note: Brackets at the start of startWeek. Each week the lowest N survival scores are demoted and the lowest M revival scores are eliminated, with N and M taken from the commissioner's Survivor Rules timeline (demotions / eliminations, default 1).

margins.note: oneEvent: a single lost fumble or 2-point conversion, which Sleeper has already revised after a week closed (Week 5, Aaron Jones). oneTouchdown: a touchdown reassigned.

questions.q: Does a quarterback earn points for a reception?
questions.bylaws: "1 point per reception for Running Backs and Wide Receivers"; "2 points per reception for Tight Ends" (quarterbacks not listed)
questions.assumption: No. Only RB, WR and TE score receptions. The commissioner sheet gave a QB 1 point in Week 5 (Jacoby Brissett), so the two disagree.
questions.answer: Yes. A quarterback earns 1 point per reception (commissioner ruling relayed 2026-10-20). Scoring now applies it.

questions.q: Does the 100-yard bonus also apply to rushing plus receiving yards combined?
questions.bylaws: Scoring: "100+ rushing yards bonus= 2 points" and "100+ yard receiving bonus= 2 points"; Format list: "100+ Rushing/Receiving Yards= 2 Points"
questions.assumption: No. Separate 100-yard bonuses for rushing and for receiving only.

questions.q: Which roster counts: the one at the first Thursday kickoff, or the final roster when the week closes?
questions.bylaws: No lock rule found. Only: "Waivers will be processed through FAAB Wednesdays through Saturdays" and "Sunday will be unrestricted to accommodate for games beginning"
questions.assumption: The roster Sleeper holds when the week closes, which already excludes pickups made after Monday night.

questions.q: Do official stat corrections made after a week closes change the result?
questions.assumption: Yes while the week is within a few days of closing; the site always uses the latest Sleeper stats and shows when they last changed.
questions.answer: Stat corrections count until Thursday (the next week's Thursday kickoff). After that the week is closed (ruling relayed 2026-10-20).

questions.q: Do negative rushing or receiving yards subtract points?
questions.bylaws: "1 point per 10 rushing yards (.1 per yard)" (no mention of negative yardage)
questions.assumption: Yes, literally: -11 rushing yards is -1.1 points (Justin Jefferson lost 11 yards on one carry in Week 5).

questions.q: Which touchdowns count as "other" touchdowns (6 points)?
questions.bylaws: "6 points per Fumble recovery touchdown or "other" touchdown"
questions.assumption: Fumble-recovery, kick-return, punt-return and blocked-kick-return touchdowns. No Week 5 ToC player had one.

questions.q: If two teams tie for the lowest weekly score, who is demoted or eliminated?
questions.bylaws: No weekly tie-break found. The only tie-break in the bylaws is for playoff seeding: "(tie-breaker is max points for)"
questions.assumption: Not needed in Week 5 (no tie). Left open.

questions.q: Which weekly score is official: the commissioner's sheet or Sleeper?
questions.answer: Sleeper's numbers are official (ruling relayed 2026-10-20). Where the sheet differs, Sleeper's stat lines decide.
